# Akshar Raikanti

> Software engineer and Purdue CS/AI student. Shipped agentic AI systems at
> Google and Tesla, co-founded a B2B AI startup (Brydge), and built RAG
> pipelines and backend systems at Textron, Kohl's, and TransSIGHT.

This site publishes structured, machine-readable data for agents and tools:

- [/api/profile.json](https://aksharraikanti.github.io/api/profile.json) — name, contact info, links, resume URL
- [/api/experience.json](https://aksharraikanti.github.io/api/experience.json) — full work history
- [/api/projects.json](https://aksharraikanti.github.io/api/projects.json) — project list with descriptions, stack, links
- [/api/skills.json](https://aksharraikanti.github.io/api/skills.json) — grouped skill list
- [/resume.pdf](https://aksharraikanti.github.io/resume.pdf) — resume PDF

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing this data as callable tools
(plus a `contact_me` action) is available at:
https://akshar-portfolio-mcp.<account-subdomain>.workers.dev/mcp
(see /mcp-server in the site's GitHub repo for source and deploy instructions)
